Advance Dental Export
=====================

Advance Dental Export at a Glance
---------------------------------

**[Advance Dental Export](https://advancedentalexport.com/ "Advance Dental Export")** is an Indian digital dental laboratory that manufactures custom dental prosthetics for dentists, dental clinics, dental laboratories, and dental distributors worldwide. Founded in 2009, the company specialises in digitally designed and precision-manufactured restorations using CAD/CAM technology, digital workflows, and premium dental materials.

The laboratory combines experienced dental technicians, modern manufacturing systems, and strict quality control to produce restorations that support predictable clinical outcomes. Advance Dental Export serves dental professionals who require consistent quality, reliable turnaround times, and accurate restorations for restorative, cosmetic, and implant dentistry.

Who We Are
----------

Advance Dental Export is dedicated exclusively to professional dental laboratory services. Our work focuses on designing and manufacturing custom restorations prescribed by licensed dental professionals. We do not provide direct patient treatment.

Since our establishment, we have continually invested in digital dentistry, advanced manufacturing equipment, and skilled technicians to meet the evolving needs of modern dental practices. Our digital-first approach enables greater precision, improved consistency, and efficient production across every case. Find our **[About Us](https://advancedentalexport.com/about-us/ "About Advance Dental Export")** here.

What We Do
----------

Advance Dental Export manufactures a wide range of custom dental restorations and prosthetic solutions, including:

*   Zirconia crowns and bridges
*   IPS e.max restorations
*   Porcelain-fused-to-metal (PFM) crowns and bridges
*   Implant-supported restorations
*   Custom implant abutments
*   Orthodontic clear aligners
*   Full-arch implant prostheses
*   Digital dentures
*   CAD/CAM restorations
*   Veneers

Our Products & Services
-----------------------

*   [**Advance Zirconia**](https://advancedentalexport.com/zirconia-crown/) – We manufacture monolithic and multilayer zirconia crowns and bridges using digital CAD/CAM workflows to deliver high-strength, biocompatible, and precisely fitting restorations.
*   [**Aesthetic Maxima IPS e.max**](https://advancedentalexport.com/emax-aesthetic-maxima/) – We fabricate IPS e.max lithium disilicate restorations for dentists who require natural translucency, accurate margins, and highly aesthetic anterior and posterior restorations.
*   [**AD-Implant**](https://advancedentalexport.com/ad-implant/) – We design and manufacture custom implant prosthetics, including implant crowns, bridges, custom abutments, and full-arch restorations using precision digital workflows.
*   [**Advanced Aligners**](https://advancedentalexport.com/advanced-aligners/) – We manufacture custom clear aligners from digital treatment plans to support predictable orthodontic tooth movement for dental professionals.
*   [**Porcelain Fused to Metal (PFM)**](https://advancedentalexport.com/porcelain-fused-to-metal-pfm/) – We manufacture porcelain fused to metal (PFM) crowns and bridges that combine a metal substructure with porcelain layering to provide durable, functional, and aesthetic restorations.

Each restoration is manufactured according to the clinical prescription and design requirements provided by the treating dentist.

Our Digital Workflow
--------------------

Our laboratory follows a digital workflow that improves manufacturing accuracy and consistency.

The workflow includes:

*   Digital impression compatibility
*   CAD restoration design
*   CAM manufacturing
*   Precision milling
*   Layering and finishing
*   Multi-stage quality inspection
*   Final verification before delivery

This process helps reduce manufacturing variations while supporting precise fit, function, and aesthetics.

Technologies We Use
-------------------

Advance Dental Export incorporates modern dental technologies throughout production, including:

*   CAD/CAM design systems
*   Digital impression workflows
*   High-precision milling technology
*   3D digital modelling
*   Implant planning support
*   Digital quality control processes

Our investment in technology allows us to manufacture restorations suitable for contemporary restorative and implant dentistry.

Quality Standards
-----------------

Quality assurance is integrated into every stage of production.

Each case is reviewed throughout the design, manufacturing, finishing, and inspection process. Material selection, restoration accuracy, marginal fit, occlusion, aesthetics, and final finishing are verified before delivery.

Our objective is to provide restorations that require minimal adjustment while supporting predictable clinical performance.

Our clients include:

Our laboratory supports both conventional and digital dental workflows.
